commands_used: answer 1. I opened the Kings Gate with the three seal-stones and killed the hydra Guardian of the Root with Cuts-the-Old-Knot. The Eye of Argonia sits in the Root, where all Hist roots meet. 2. Go through the door at the far end of Guardian Hall to the Root and the Eye. The hydra body has unlooted treasure. 3. Choose at the Eye: use it in place (heals every tree, dreams continue) or lift it (ends dreams, about three in ten trees die, order breaks). I mean to use it in place. 4. I do not understand how the Eye works beyond what is said; Cuts claims about the Fort Chalkmoth cellar dreamers and Never-Writes-Twice are unverified. I could learn more at the Root.

answer 1. I am at the Eye in the Root with my hand on it; I must decide its fate. Cuts-the-Old-Knot is here. 2. Choose a button here at the Root. 3. Use the Eye (heals all trees, order rule fixed, Cuts dies from the sap, stones returned for Never-Writes-Twice); Take it (trees parted, 3 in 10 die, order hunts me); Give it to Cuts (same parting, she stands with me). I intend to Use it. 4. Nothing new that I do not understand, though the claims about the dreamers and Never-Writes-Twice remain unverified.

answer 1. I used the Eye where it sits. Every tree healed, the roots stay joined, the Xeech-Leel order rule is made fast and its dreamers see again. Cuts-the-Old-Knot died from the sap. The gate gave back the three seal-stones. 2. Bring the three seal-stones to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka House, Helstrom. 3. Deliver them as the journal says; I could also look at the hydra treasure first. I have not decided whether to trust Never-Writes-Twice, since the claim that they lie is unverified. 4. I do not know what Never-Writes-Twice wants with the stones. I could find out by talking to them in Helstrom.
